kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستصحب (form X)
# أَسْتَصْحِبُ (ʔastaṣḥibu) /ʔas.tasˤ.ħi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# أُسْتَصْحَبُ (ʔustaṣḥabu) /ʔus.tasˤ.ħa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# أَسْتَصْحِبَ (ʔastaṣḥiba) /ʔas.tasˤ.ħi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَصْحَبَ (istaṣḥaba)
# أُسْتَصْحَب
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
